attribution.name: 欧阳询
attribution.note: Both Palace Museum entries name Ouyang Xun as the writer of the stone; the museum's biography gives 557–641, making this a late work.
attribution.noteZh: 故宫两处著录均以欧阳询为书者；馆方小传记其生卒为 557—641，故此碑属晚年之作。

compositionDate.note: The Palace Museum gives the tenth month of 637 for the erection of the stone.

background: A funerary stele for the chancellor Wen Yanbo, set up at Zhaoling in Liquan in the tenth month of 637: 36 lines of 77 characters, with a seal-script heading of four lines and sixteen characters. The lower half of the stone broke away in the Song, and no complete rubbing survives; the best early impressions carry only about eight hundred characters of roughly two thousand eight hundred.
backgroundZh: 此为温彦博的墓碑，贞观十一年（637）十月立于醴泉昭陵：正书三十六行、行七十七字，篆额四行十六字。碑之下半入宋已断裂，故无全文拓本；传世最旧之本仅存八百余字，而全文约二千八百余字。

review.note: Draft record from two Palace Museum object entries and a National Library collection survey, all read on 2026-11-23. They agree on date, authorship and line count. Neither the stone nor a rubbing was examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的故宫两处著录与国家图书馆藏石刻叙录整理。三处在年代、撰书人与行款上一致。未核对原石与拓本。

notes: The character total is given as 约二千八百余字 by the National Library survey; it is not a count of any surviving impression.
The record keeps the stone and the Palace Museum's Southern Song rubbing as separate objects, because a rubbing has its own production date and holding.
The stone is at Zhaoling; that is the burial complex of Taizong, and the stele is one of its attendant monuments. The record does not describe the site's present arrangements.
notesZh: 「约二千八百余字」是国家图书馆叙录所记全文规模，不是任何传世拓本的实际存字。
本记录将原石与故宫藏南宋拓本分列为两件实物：拓本自有制作年代与收藏。
原石在昭陵，即唐太宗陵园，此碑为陪葬碑之一。本记录不描述陵园现状。
